_about: View limits feel (kb: decisions/controls "View limits", user report 2026-10-25): at the zoom-out limit in the user's full-screen window, a two-finger scroll pushes the set up past the bound and lifts (the band springs back at once, the momentum after the lift is cut); a flick down whose momentum runs into the lower bound (brakes on the band, springs back while the momentum still arrives); a mouse drag right past the bound, released. `almondbread fly --script scripts/flights/limits-feel.json --log x.csv`: center_re / center_im per refresh.
